"''I wouldn't dream of it.|TC-70 and Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=WiseAndPowerfulJabba-TCWf.flac|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]}} '''TC-70''' was [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] went to negotiate with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] upon [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta's]] kidnapping, TC-70 helped to translate her master and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] conversation. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] stated that Jabba wanted his son back and the kidnappers found either dead or alive. She also received [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] as he entered Jabba's palace in search of his [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Padawan]], she asked for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which he then recovered. The droid was also present for the negotiations between Jabba and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] over the job of securing the plans to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] and securing the release of [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] following his imprisonment for involvement in the kidnapping of Rotta. TC-70 also translated the conversation of the members of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] for Bane, revealing their intentions to free Ziro to keep certain secrets of the Hutt crime syndicates safe. TC-70 served as the translator for [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] during his conversation with Jabba following a confrontation with Jabba's bounty hunter, [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], during his search for his abducted daughters, [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway]] and [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe]]. By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], as [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] established the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]], TC-70 was no longer serving as Jabba's translator. ==Behind the scenes== TC-70 was voiced by [[Nika Futterman]], who also voiced [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]]. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of TC-70}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] {{Ab|Star Wars: The Clone Wars (audiobook)}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' junior novelization]] *''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Movie Storybook]]'' *{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}} *{{TCW|Evil Plans}} *{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}} *''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Crisis on Coruscant]]'' ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' {{C|Cutscene only}} ==Sources== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of TC-70}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' *{{SWArchive|url=fans/media/womenofsw/index.html?page=3|text=The Women of ''Star Wars'': The Women of the Prequel Trilogy}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |hu=TC-70 |nl=TC-70 |pl=TC-70 |pt=Legends:TC-70 }} [[Category:Droids of the Hutt Clan]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified gender programming]] [[Category:TC-series protocol droids]]
